name: London local authority National Scheme of Delegation status

properties.name: Barking and Dagenham
properties.evidence_summary: Planning Committee report says arrangements were being implemented but formal constitutional changes would be considered by Assembly in November.

properties.name: Barnet
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council considered the Monitoring Officer's constitutional amendments, including committee terms, officer delegations, planning code and Planning Scheme of Management.

properties.name: Bexley
properties.evidence_summary: The scheme of delegation and Planning Committee terms of reference were listed for Council on 4 November, after commencement; no earlier adoption decision was located.

properties.name: Brent
properties.evidence_summary: Extraordinary Full Council considered and approved constitutional and Planning Committee terms-of-reference changes for the NSD.

properties.name: Bromley
properties.evidence_summary: Council retained three planning bodies with reduced membership until May 2027 and introduced the statutory gateway arrangements from 31 October.

properties.name: Camden
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council resolved to approve constitutional amendments aligning Camden with the NSD.

properties.name: City of London Corporation
properties.evidence_summary: The City is not a London borough. Consultation-stage material was located, but no 2026 implementation decision was confirmed in this AI-only review.

properties.name: Croydon
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council received the General Purposes Committee recommendations and amended Parts 3, 4K and 5D for the NSD.

properties.name: Ealing
properties.evidence_summary: Council adopted new planning decision rules and a Planning Committee Gateway Protocol.

properties.name: Enfield
properties.evidence_summary: Council approved constitutional changes, revised Planning Committee terms, referral protocol, planning code and gateway request form.

properties.name: Hackney
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council adopted new Planning Committee terms of reference effective 31 October and delegated consequential amendments to the Monitoring Officer.

properties.name: Hammersmith and Fulham
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council's constitution review included and approved the NSD appendix and associated officer-responsibility changes.

properties.name: Haringey
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council considered constitutional changes implementing the NSD before commencement.

properties.name: Harrow
properties.evidence_summary: Council approved constitutional and planning-procedure updates aligned with the NSD.

properties.name: Havering
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council approved constitutional amendments and a replacement Planning Committee; the council published confirmation.

properties.name: Hillingdon
properties.evidence_summary: Council approved an updated Chapter 7 on Planning Decisions, effective 31 October.

properties.name: Hounslow
properties.evidence_summary: Special Council approved revised Planning Committee terms, nominated roles and consequential constitutional amendments.

properties.name: Islington
properties.evidence_summary: Council approved constitutional amendments effective 31 October and disbanded the Planning Sub-Committees.

properties.name: Kensington and Chelsea
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council adopted planning procedure changes for the NSD, including revised committee arrangements and nominated roles.

properties.name: Kingston upon Thames
properties.evidence_summary: Council considered and approved the Corporate and Resources Committee recommendation to amend the Constitution for the 2026 Regulations.

properties.name: Lambeth
properties.evidence_summary: Council approved 2026/27 constitutional changes including the NSD and gateway arrangements.

properties.name: Lewisham
properties.evidence_summary: Council resolved to replace local referral thresholds with the national schedules and gateway test, nominate roles, and amend the Constitution.

properties.name: Merton
properties.evidence_summary: The Development and Planning Applications Committee approved the new delegation and gateway arrangements.

properties.name: Newham
properties.evidence_summary: Constitution updates and planning reforms were on the Full Council agenda on the snapshot date; no published outcome was available when checked.

properties.name: Redbridge
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council considered the revised Constitution and planning committee reforms for implementation from 31 October.

properties.name: Richmond upon Thames
properties.evidence_summary: The council publicly described implementation and the loss of local call-in from 31 October, but a formal constitutional adoption resolution was not located.

properties.name: Royal Borough of Greenwich
properties.evidence_summary: Council approved changes to the Constitution for the NSD.

properties.name: Southwark
properties.evidence_summary: Post-commencement committee papers show the nominated officer/member gateway operating under the NSD.

properties.name: Sutton
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council considered the Strategy and Resources Committee recommendation and constitutional planning reforms.

properties.name: Tower Hamlets
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council approved reforms to both planning committees, terms of reference and the statutory gateway arrangements.

properties.name: Waltham Forest
properties.evidence_summary: Full Council adopted revised Planning Committee rules aligned to the 2026 Regulations.

properties.name: Wandsworth
properties.evidence_summary: Council confirmed that Full Council changed the Constitution on 21 October, effective for decisions from 1 November.

properties.name: Westminster
